English:
Jun 21, 1985 - Nearly got spotted yesterday. Been out here so long now, I'm in danger of getting complacent. Gotta stay sharp.

The word came through from HQ that Armstrong's managed to lead a successful attack on the airport to the North. I knew that guy looked smart. Next time I see him, I'll have to give him my congratulations.

If he manages to stay alive, that is.

With US forces back on Everon, the Commies are running around like crazy - a good time for me to make a move, while they're distracted trying to re-take the airport. The top priority target has got to be their chopper base, and we've got a lead on a possible location. So tonight I'm going Hind-hunting...

来点儿口香糖？
谢谢，不用了。只有你们两个吗？盯梢的哪儿去了？
他正盯着俄国人呢。整晚都有一大群卡车向北驶去。
看来他们大概在给什么东西造基地吧。
行了，不管它是什么东西，我们得到的命令是去找到它，并且把它夷为平地。出发。
我要去把盯梢的叫来吗？
不必了，我们在路上带上他。
是，长官，您带路。
